🚀 material-maker | GDScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Creating and painting 3D materials using a procedural, node-based workflow.
✨ Key Features: • Procedural texture authoring • 3D model painting • Node-based interface (Godot GraphEdit) • Texture and brush creation through interconnected nodes
📖 Summary: Material Maker is a tool built on the Godot Engine for procedurally generating textures and painting 3D models. It utilizes a node-based interface, similar to Godot's GraphEdit, allowing users to define textures and brushes through interconnected nodes.
